name: General Emergency
primary_causes: Medical diversions, bird strikes, cabin pressurization, engine anomalies
note: Routine emergency alert handled daily by ATC worldwide

name: Radio Failure
primary_causes: Frequency handoff delay, stuck PTT microphone, avionics reboot
note: Secondary operational fix resolved via standard lost-comm routing

name: Accidental Dial-In
primary_causes: Pilot rotary transposer typo (transposing digits), test errors
note: 85%+ of 7500 transmissions are false alarms retracted in <60 seconds

name: Verified Hijacking
primary_causes: Unlawful interference, flight deck physical struggle
note: Extremely rare statistical outlier (<1 per 50 million flights)
